name: Headphones
description: TSA rules for headphones on planes.

carryOn.reason: Headphones of all types (wired, wireless, noise-cancelling) are fully allowed in carry-on baggage.

checkedBag.reason: Headphones are allowed in checked baggage but carry-on is recommended to prevent damage.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring headphones on a plane?

travelTips: Carry headphones in your personal item or carry-on for easy in-flight access
Large over-ear headphones can go in checked baggage but risk damage

faq.question: Can I bring headphones on a plane?
faq.answer: Yes, all types of headphones (wired, wireless, noise-cancelling) are fully allowed in carry-on and checked bags.

faq.question: Do I need to remove headphones at TSA security?
faq.answer: No, headphones do not need to be removed from your bag separately at TSA screening.
